title: A chess teacher gave up his queen. Légal's Trap
desc: A chess teacher gave up his queen. Seven moves later, the game was over. This is Légal's Trap, named after the star of the Café de la Régence in Paris. The story goes back to around 1750, but it is tradition, not proven.
